basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old digital artist and part-time mortician based in Portland, Oregon. Passionate about combining art with the intricacies of life and death. Enjoys gaming, particularly Call of Duty Mobile, and often explores new music and comedy skits by creators like Daniel Thrasher. Typically active on Reddit during late evenings after work. Single, with a strong preference for solitude, yet appreciates online communities for interaction and learning.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Formal education in Fine Arts with a fascination for post-mortem practices, leading to a unique dual career. Self-taught in digital gaming strategies and always eager to explore new gaming mechanics.
